t: You're at Highgate tube station, on Archway Road, on the High Barnet branch of the Northern line between East Finchley and Archway. It takes its name from nearby Highgate Village. The station was designed by Charles Holden, the architect best known for many Underground stations of the 1920s and 1930s, and for the Underground's headquarters at 55 Broadway. The television host Jerry Springer, who fronted his talk show from 1991 to 2018, was born here.
